# TS-002: Node key expiry is disabled on server nodes

- **Group:** Tailscale
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Tailscale node keys expire (180 days by default). When a server's key expires the node logs out on its own, usually unattended, and every tailnet scoped rule turns dead (see TS-001). Servers should have key expiry disabled in the admin console.

## Verify by hand

```sh
tailscale status --json | grep KeyExpiry
```

## How to fix it

Disable key expiry for this machine in the Tailscale admin console (Machines, the node, Disable key expiry)

## What a fix can break

Nothing on the host; a stolen node key then stays valid until you remove the node, so protect the host itself.
